_comment: Checkpoint manifest for the weiqi time machine. The demo builds one slider stop per entry; adding future checkpoints only needs new files + new entries here — no code changes.

selfplay.about: PPO from scratch vs frozen snapshots of itself (M1/MPS, corrected training semantics). Continued 6M to 15.5M at 6.5 training komi (fairer for Black on 9x9). At 15.5M the net is 7-25 vs GNU Go levels 1-10 (greedy play, 7.5 komi): first Black wins ever (2-14, avg margin -18.3) after 0-16 at 6M, but overall flat — the komi lever helped a little, not a lot.
selfplay.label: Self-play RL

supervised.about: Behavioral cloning on 273k human 9x9 positions (Go Quest), then PPO fine-tuning from the imitation checkpoint. Pure imitation scores 74-182 (28.9%) vs GNU Go; 3M PPO steps reach 118-138 (46.1%); plain PPO plateaus at 6M with 129-127 (50.4%) and 9M with 118-138 (46.1%). Interleaving a behavioral-cloning phase on the human positions during PPO (3M to 6M, same budget) breaks the plateau: 156-100 (60.9%) — the default model. A follow-up fine-tune distilling the model's own MCTS-100 search visits into the policy (last timeline stop) reached 160-100 (62.5%) vs GNU Go but lost a 256-game head-to-head against this checkpoint 116-140, so the two are statistically tied and the established champion keeps the default.
supervised.label: Supervised
